name: command-palette-card
title: CommandPaletteCard
purpose: Grouped command palette that reaches projects, actions, and settings from one search.
avoidFor: Unrelated content forced into one surface
Pinned geometry or elevation that bypasses the active theme
accessibility: Heading level follows the surrounding document hierarchy.
Interactive controls retain native keyboard and focus behavior through Balsa primitives.
Supporting text and status do not rely on color alone.
commonMistakes: Pinning radius, border, or shadow instead of inheriting the design context.
Replacing the typed data contract with demo-only DOM.
Adding a second principal card surface.

props.name: description
props.default: "One search across projects, people and settings."

props.name: groups
props.default: [ { id: "projects", label: "Projects", items: [ { id: "atlas", label: "Atlas", icon: Boxes, shortcut: "1" }, { id: "relay", label: "Relay", icon: Boxes, shortcut: "2" }, { id: "harbor", label: "Harbor", icon: Boxes, shortcut: "3" }, ], }, { id: "actions", label: "Actions", items: [ { id: "deploy", label: "Deploy the current commit", icon: Rocket }, { id: "branch", label: "Open a preview branch", icon: GitBranch }, { id: "logs", label: "Stream production logs", icon: ScrollText }, ], }, ]

props.name: recents
props.type: readonly { id: string; label: string; detail: string; }[] | undefined
props.default: [ { id: "atlas-logs", label: "Atlas production logs", detail: "8 minutes ago" }, { id: "relay-preview", label: "Relay preview branch", detail: "1 hour ago" }, { id: "members", label: "Members and roles", detail: "Yesterday" }, ]
